```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

# ---- settings: change these if your experiment changes ----------------------
RESULTS_DIR <- "results"   # folder written by run_experiments.py
DRIFT_EVERY <- 5000        # steps between concept drifts
N_UP        <- 3           # consecutive rises of the rolling reward that count as "recovery"
CHANCE      <- 1 / 7       # expected reward of uniformly random actions (7 actions)

# Display names and plotting order for each condition (file names are <condition>_seed<seed>.csv)
condition_labels <- c(
  sigmoid_default = "Sigmoid (default)",
  relu            = "ReLU",
  tanh            = "Tanh",
  leaky_relu      = "Leaky ReLU",
  `gamma_0.01`    = "gamma = 0.01",
  `gamma_0.05`    = "gamma = 0.05",
  `gamma_0.10`    = "gamma = 0.10",
  `gm_0.01`       = "gamma_model = 0.01",
  `gm_0.05`       = "gamma_model = 0.05",
  `gm_0.20`       = "gamma_model = 0.20",
  `gm_0.30`       = "gamma_model = 0.30",
  `tanh_gm_0.30`  = "Tanh + gamma_model = 0.30",
  `leaky_gm_0.30` = "Leaky ReLU + gamma_model = 0.30"
)

# Which conditions go in which figure. The default run is gamma = 0.005 AND gamma_model = 0.10.
groups <- list(
  "Activation functions"      = c("sigmoid_default", "relu", "tanh", "leaky_relu"),
  "Per-step exploration (gamma; default = 0.005)" =
    c("sigmoid_default", "gamma_0.01", "gamma_0.05", "gamma_0.10"),
  "Configuration exploration (gamma_model; default = 0.10)" =
    c("gm_0.01", "gm_0.05", "sigmoid_default", "gm_0.20", "gm_0.30"),
  "Combined settings"         =
    c("tanh", "tanh_gm_0.30", "leaky_relu", "leaky_gm_0.30")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: functions

read_run <- function(file) {
  read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    arrange(step) %>%
    mutate(drift_event = as.logical(drift_event))
}

# TRUE where the last `n` logged values of x were each higher than the one before.
run_of_rises <- function(x, n) {
  up  <- c(FALSE, diff(x) > 0)
  out <- up
  if (n > 1) for (k in 1:(n - 1)) out <- out & dplyr::lag(up, k, default = FALSE)
  out
}

# Detect recovery after every drift in one run.
#
# Rule: a drift is "recovered" at the first logged step after
# it, and before the next drift, where the rolling reward has risen N_UP times in a row.
#
# post_drift_only = TRUE  (default): all N_UP rises must happen AFTER the drift.
#   The earliest possible detection is then drift + N_UP * 500 steps.
# A drift that lands on the very last step cannot be recovered from, so it is dropped.
detect_recoveries <- function(metrics, n_up = N_UP, post_drift_only = TRUE) {
  last_step    <- max(metrics$step)
  drift_points <- metrics %>% filter(drift_event) %>% pull(step) %>% sort()
  drift_points <- drift_points[drift_points < last_step]
  next_drifts  <- c(drift_points[-1], Inf)

  if (!post_drift_only) {
    metrics <- metrics %>% mutate(signal = run_of_rises(rolling_reward, n_up))
  }

  map2_dfr(drift_points, next_drifts, function(d, nb) {
    pre_drift_reward <- metrics$rolling_reward[metrics$step == d][1]

    if (post_drift_only) {
      # segment starts at the drift row, which serves as the baseline for the first rise
      seg <- metrics %>% filter(step >= d, step < nb)
      seg$signal <- run_of_rises(seg$rolling_reward, n_up)
      cand <- seg %>% filter(step > d, signal)
    } else {
      cand <- metrics %>% filter(step > d, step < nb, signal)
    }

    found <- nrow(cand) > 0
    tibble(
      drift_step       = d,
      recovered        = found,
      recovery_step    = if (found) cand$step[1] else NA_real_,
      rolling_reward   = if (found) cand$rolling_reward[1] else NA_real_,
      pre_drift_reward = pre_drift_reward
    )
  }) %>%
    mutate(
      recovery_time = recovery_step - drift_step,
      above_chance  = rolling_reward > CHANCE   # NA when not recovered
    )
}

# Plot one run with drift (red) and recovery (blue) markers.
plot_run <- function(metrics, rec, title) {
  ggplot(metrics, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = CHANCE, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = metrics$step[metrics$drift_event],
               linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = rec$recovery_step[rec$recovered],
               linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", linewidth = 0.6) +
    labs(title = title,
         subtitle = "Red = concept drift | Blue = detected recovery | Grey = random-action level (1/7)",
         x = "Training steps", y = "Rolling reward") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# 95% confidence half-width across seeds (t distribution)
ci95 <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 2) return(NA_real_)
  qt(0.975, n - 1) * sd(x) / sqrt(n)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load

run_index <- tibble(file = list.files(RESULTS_DIR, pattern = "_seed[0-9]+\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = sub("_seed[0-9]+\\.csv$", "", basename(file)),
    seed      = as.integer(sub(".*_seed([0-9]+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(file)))
  )

if (nrow(run_index) == 0) stop("No result files found in '", RESULTS_DIR, "'. Run run_experiments.py first.")

unknown <- setdiff(unique(run_index$condition), names(condition_labels))
if (length(unknown) > 0) stop("Add these conditions to condition_labels: ", paste(unknown, collapse = ", "))

runs <- run_index %>% mutate(metrics = map(file, read_run))

cond_label <- function(x) factor(unname(condition_labels[x]), levels = unname(condition_labels))

# Sanity check: every condition should have the same seeds and the same run length.
run_index %>%
  mutate(steps = map_dbl(runs$metrics, ~ max(.x$step))) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(seeds = n(), min_steps = min(steps), max_steps = max(steps), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(condition = condition_labels[condition]) %>%
  kable(caption = "Runs found per condition (check: same number of seeds and steps everywhere).")
```

```{r}
#| label: recoveries

recoveries <- runs %>%
  mutate(rec = map(metrics, detect_recoveries)) %>%
  select(condition, seed, rec) %>%
  unnest(rec)

per_run <- recoveries %>%
  group_by(condition, seed) %>%
  summarise(
    drifts                  = n(),
    recovered               = sum(recovered),
    recovery_rate           = recovered / drifts,
    mean_recovery_time      = mean(recovery_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reward_at_recovery = mean(rolling_reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    recoveries_below_chance = sum(!above_chance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    runs %>%
      mutate(
        mean_rolling_reward   = map_dbl(metrics, ~ mean(.x$rolling_reward)),
        final_cumulative_regret = map_dbl(metrics, ~ dplyr::last(.x$cumulative_regret))
      ) %>%
      select(condition, seed, mean_rolling_reward, final_cumulative_regret),
    by = c("condition", "seed")
  )

by_condition <- per_run %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_seeds = n(),
    across(
      c(recovery_rate, mean_recovery_time, mean_reward_at_recovery,
        mean_rolling_reward, final_cumulative_regret),
      list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), ci95 = ci95),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(condition = cond_label(condition)) %>%
  arrange(condition)

write_csv(recoveries, "recoveries_all_runs.csv")
write_csv(per_run, "summary_per_run.csv")
write_csv(by_condition, "summary_by_condition.csv")
```

# Summary across seeds

Mean and 95% confidence half-width (t distribution) over seeds. Recovery rate is the fraction of
drifts with a detected recovery; a drift on the final step is excluded.

```{r}
#| label: summary-table
by_condition %>%
  transmute(
    Condition = condition,
    Seeds = n_seeds,
    `Recovery rate` = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", recovery_rate__mean, recovery_rate__ci95),
    `Mean recovery time` = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f", mean_recovery_time__mean, mean_recovery_time__ci95),
    `Reward at recovery` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_reward_at_recovery__mean, mean_reward_at_recovery__ci95),
    `Mean rolling reward` = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_rolling_reward__mean, mean_rolling_reward__ci95),
    `Final cum. regret` = sprintf("%.0f ± %.0f", final_cumulative_regret__mean, final_cumulative_regret__ci95)
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

# Rolling reward by experiment

Lines are the mean over seeds; bands are one standard deviation. Dashed red lines are drifts and
the dotted grey line is the random-action level (1/7).

```{r}
#| label: curves
for (g in names(groups)) {
  p <- curve_summary %>%
    filter(condition %in% groups[[g]]) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = step, y = mean, color = label, fill = label)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(
        ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0),
        ymax = pmin(mean + sd, 1)
      ),
      alpha = 0.07,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = drift_steps,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = CHANCE,
      linetype = "dotted",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.85) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, max_step, by = DRIFT_EVERY),
      labels = scales::label_number(
        scale = 1 / 1000,
        suffix = "k"
      )
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Rolling reward:", g),
      subtitle = "Shaded regions = ±1 SD across seeds | Red dashed lines = concept drift",
      x = "Training steps",
      y = "Mean rolling reward",
      color = NULL,
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    ) +
    guides(fill = "none")
  print(p)
}
```

# Recovery map

Share of seeds in which each drift was recovered (1 = every seed).

```{r}
#| label: recovery-map
#| fig-height: 5.5
recoveries %>%
  group_by(condition, drift_step) %>%
  summarise(frac = mean(recovered), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = forcats::fct_rev(cond_label(condition))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(drift_step / 1000), y = label, fill = frac)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = "Drift (thousand steps)", y = NULL, fill = "Seeds recovered",
       title = "Recovery by drift and condition") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Appendix: individual runs (first seed of each condition)

```{r}
#| label: single-runs
#| fig-height: 4
first_seed <- min(runs$seed)
for (cond in names(condition_labels)) {
  i <- which(runs$condition == cond & runs$seed == first_seed)
  if (length(i) == 0) next
  rec <- detect_recoveries(runs$metrics[[i]])
  print(plot_run(runs$metrics[[i]], rec,
                 paste0(condition_labels[[cond]], " (seed ", first_seed, ")")))
  print(kable(rec %>% select(drift_step, recovered, recovery_step, recovery_time, rolling_reward)))
}
```
